judged_text: The new externalId parameter is accepted and echoed into the EventResult but never passed to calendar.createEvent, and the non-credentialId call sites in EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents invoke createEvent without it, so result.externalId is undefined on that path. adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts`, `createEvent` now accepts `externalId?: string` and returns it in the `EventResult` (`externalId, credentialId: credential.id`), but it never uses/passes that `externalId` into the calendar integration call (`calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)`). In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, booking references now store `externalCalendarId: result.externalId` (replacing the prior `evt.destinationCalendar?.externalId`). However, in `createAllCalendarEvents`, the branch for destination calendars without `credentialId` calls `createEvent(c, event)` without the third argument (so `result.externalId` becomes `undefined` on that path). This is a concrete regression in what gets persisted: credential-less destination calendar creations will produce booking references with `externalCalendarId: undefined` even though the destination object includes an `externalId`.
